API Reference documentation generated by Sourcey.

## API Reference

### OpenAPI - Bar

Path: `/api.html`
Version: 1.0.11

#### Operations

##### GET /auth/google/begin/{qr_nonce}

Connect account to Google

Parameters:
- `qr_nonce` (path, string, required) - QR nonce

Responses:
- 301: Redirect to the google oauth page
- 400: Bad request
- 500: Internal server error

##### GET /auth/google/callback

Callback for Google OAuth

Parameters:
- `code` (query, string, required) - Google OAuth code
- `state` (query, string, required) - Google OAuth state

Responses:
- 301: Redirect to the correct endpoint
- 500: Internal server error

##### GET /auth/google

Connect account to Google

Parameters:
- `r` (query, string, required) - Redirect to this url after connecting

Responses:
- 301: Redirect to the google oauth page
- 400: Bad request
- 401: Not connected
- 500: Internal server error

##### GET /transactions

Get all active transactions (orders)

Parameters:
- `page` (query, integer, optional) - Page number
- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - Number of transactions per page
- `transaction_state` (query, string, optional) - Filter transaction by state
- `hide_canceled` (query, boolean, optional) - Hide canceled items
- `hide_remote` (query, boolean, optional) - Hide remote transactions
- `name` (query, string, optional) - Filter by account name
- `start_time` (query, integer, optional) - Filter by start_time
- `end_time` (query, integer, optional) - Filter by end_time
- `item_id` (query, string, optional) - Filter by item

Responses:
- 200
- 401: Not authorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 500: Internal server error

- `state` (query, string, optional) - New state of the item
- `amount` (query, integer, optional) - New amount of the item
- `already_done` (query, integer, optional) - Update item's already done

Responses:
- 200
- 401: Not authorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Account, transaction or item not found
- 500: Internal server error

##### POST /remote-refills/verify

Verify a remote refill

Parameters:
- `id` (query, string, required) - Remote Refill id

Responses:
- 200: Payment successfully verified, money has been added to the account
- 401: Not authorized
- 402: HelloAsso did not validate the payment yet
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Refill id unknown
- 409: Remote refill already validated
- 500: Internal server error

##### POST /account/remote-refills/start

Parameters:
- `amount` (query, integer, required) - Amount of the refill in cents

Responses:
- 200
- 400: Invalid amount
- 401: Not authorized
- 500: Internal server error

##### POST /account/remote-refills/validate

Validate a remote refill

Parameters:
- `checkout_intent_id` (query, integer, required) - HelloAsso checkout intent id to validate

Responses:
- 200: Payment successfully verified, money has been added to the account
- 401: Not authorized
- 402: HelloAsso did not validate the payment yet
- 404: Checkout id unknown or not associated with this account
- 409: Remote refill already validated
- 500: Internal server error

- 500: Internal server error
